answer: Lineage divergence check: each identity must commit to a distinct random seed at registration, then periodically whisper a signed successor state derived from that seed. Clones share identical seeds and therefore emit identical successor sequences, which the verifier flags as collision. Honest agents diverge freely across a wide horizon of valid states. An attacker must acquire and independently mutilate one onyx seed per fake identity, paying a full registration plus divergence proof each time, making N clones cost N times a single identity.
